name: task-14
_ambiguities: Scrolling to the associated question after a contents click is not asserted: no op checks the scroll position. Only the click is performed and the console is checked.
The reorder by drag is not verified: no op compares question order, and titles are random. Only the drag completing, the item count staying at 8, and clickability are checked.
Each contents item's text equal to its question title is not asserted (titles are random).
'Fixed at the right side' is not verifiable with the ops available; only the .contents panel's visibility is checked.
The count of 8 assumes one contents item per question, with 8 questions added by the flow (Question, Single, Multi, Open, Rating, Ranking, Nps, Likert).
expect_all_clickable is used as the check that the contents panel does not cover question controls. It does not check overlap of non-interactive question content.
The contents item selector assumes .contents-item rows are direct children of .contents in order (nth-child).
